collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SL Class 1989 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz SL Class Roadster 1989 to 2001 (129) requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
